about: Source-checked defects in the PDF's extracted text layer. Extracted text is never edited; these entries are shown alongside it. `extracted` must match the extracted text exactly; `reading` is what the printed page shows; `verified_id` names the verified transcription that shows it, when one exists.

defects.reading: the velocity head is computed as V²/2g
defects.note: The text layer drops 'computed as V' from the inline expression on printed p. 4-15.
